question: Who is the first woman President of the Astronomical Society of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. GC Anupama**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. GC Anupama** is the first woman President of the Astronomical Society of India.
 
• The Astronomical Society of India (ASI) is the primary association of professional astronomers in India.
 
• Dr. GC Anupama has made significant contributions to the field of astronomy and has held various prestigious positions in her career.
 
• Her leadership role in the ASI marks a significant milestone in promoting gender equality in the field of astronomy in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Astronomical Society of India was established in 1972 to promote the growth and development of astronomy and astrophysics in India.
 
• It organizes annual meetings, seminars, and workshops to facilitate the exchange of scientific knowledge among astronomers.
 
• Dr. GC Anupama's election as President is seen as an inspiration for many young women aspiring to pursue careers in science and astronomy.
 
• The ASI also engages in outreach programs to popularize astronomy among students and the general public.
